MRI Safety Information
The Meridian Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. A person with the Meridian Coronary Stent System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Meridian Coronary Stent System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3 Tesla only
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1 W/kg
Scan Duration Scan for up to 60 minutes.
Scan Regions Landmark the scan at least 30 cm away from the implanted pulse generator
